events.title: Bicycle Deliveries, Faster Days, and Improvements!
events.summary: Transport Boxes by Bicycle You can now place boxes from the electronics store in your bicycle's cargo area! This allows you to transport boxes using your bicycle and complete deliveries more conveniently and efficiently. We've also fixed an issue that prevented the map from opening while riding a bicycle. events.title: October 3 Update Notes
events.summary: Added a bicycle to the game. Adjusted customer arrival intervals. Made various performance improvements.

events.title: August 26 Update Notes:
events.summary: Checkout interaction has been improved. The player's position at the register and the camera angle have been adjusted to provide a more comfortable and playable experience. The cash payment interface has been improved. When receiving a cash payment, the “Total Amount” field now changes to “Change”. This is intended to make it easier for players to understand how much change they need to give the customer.

events.title: August 25 Update Notes
events.summary: Various dialogue improvements have been made. The checkout notification sound has been changed. Nighttime ambient sounds have been adjusted. Some quest texts have been improved to make them clearer. The visuals and functionality of several UI buttons have been adjusted. In-game time now stops at 00:00 (midnight). events.title: August 23 Update Notes
events.summary: Tip durations have been extended and tip rates have been increased. Video playback has been added to the television. Explanatory text has been added to the puzzles in the Golden Boxes. Additional information has been added for using the compass. Pricing issues affecting some products have been fixed. Various optimizations have been made to improve performance.

events.title: Market Manager Simulator Demo Is OUT NOW! 🛒
events.summary: It’s time to build and manage your very own supermarket. Start small, stock your shelves, set your prices, serve your customers, and grow your business step by step. In the demo, you’ll be able to experience the beginning of your journey as a market manager. Order products, organize your shelves, manage prices, serve customers, expand your store, hire employees, and keep your market running smoothly. Every decision is yours. Can you turn a small market into a successful business? 📈 Play the demo
